entities.name: Nelson's Dockyard and British Naval Power
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: English Harbour became one of Britain's most important Caribbean naval bases. Horatio Nelson served as captain there in the 1780s, and the dockyard played a key role in protecting British sugar trade routes.
